name: Warren Crescent Play Area
description: Play area near the junction of Warren Crescent and Ridge Road, marked by a public footpath sign, with a slide and climbing frame and swings for older children, and swings and springers for toddlers, as Eckington Parish Council describes it.
operator: Eckington Parish Council (inspected by North East Derbyshire District Council)
